problem_type: Reference clip-state rendering loses foreground, opacity, and state precedence
symptom: Director timeline labels darken in dark mode; hovering, selecting, and activating clips do not match the approved reference design.
direct_cause: ClipBar overrides inherited text with theme-flipping paper, leaves normal opacity and hover rules enabled when selected, and applies only a border for active paths.
class_root: The shared clip presentation boundary models a family background instead of the complete family and interaction-state appearance.
affected_population: Normal, hover, active, selected, and selected-plus-active clips
entry_points: TrackLanes action, pose, and look-at lanes

external_sources.purpose: Confirm state color utilities; the reference clip-state precedence and label inheritance were checked against the approved reference design.

invariants: Selected overrides active and normal hover styling
Semantic foregrounds, selected borders, and handles do not invert with app theme
All families use one complete state resolver
generality_proof: Both primary and secondary lanes render ClipBar; its exhaustive ClipTone mapping owns foreground and background together and chooses exactly one state before rendering. No caller can retain normal hover styling on a selected clip.

shared_boundaries.responsibility: Resolve the full family and state class set with selected precedence.
Inherit the resolved foreground and render fixed white selection handles.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: primary path and closeup ClipBar rendering
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Primary row clips are dispatched by clip.family to the same ClipBar; active applies only to trajectory.

same_class_entry_points.entry_point: secondary action, pose, and lookat ClipTone inputs
same_class_entry_points.evidence: Every TimelineClipView tone goes through the shared resolver; no label span color override remains.

recurrence.reason: Any user can repeat the error by changing theme or selecting any clip family.
same_class_scan: rg CLIP_TONE_CLASS|clipToneStyle|FAMILY_TONE: only ClipBar consumes the first two; FAMILY_TONE is unused
Read TrackLanes main/secondary clips, ClipBar label and handles, and root light/dark tokens
Compared the reference state precedence and inherited clip label against all five variants

prevention.invariant: Each typed family has normal and selected styles; selected and active return before ordinary hover rules.
prevention.failure_mode: TypeScript rejects missing family mappings; computed browser state checks fail on incorrect color, opacity, or precedence.
prevention.strategy: Select one complete appearance at the shared boundary and make labels inherit it.

legacy_paths.rationale: Remove empty clipToneStyle compatibility shell, unused FAMILY_TONE, theme-dependent label override, and split state handling.

dependency_lifecycle.rationale: This is application-owned state mapping; existing Tailwind 3 token and variant support is sufficient without dependency changes.

migration: No project/schema changes. Existing clips obtain the corrected presentation on next render.
residual_risks: Validated locally with 160 browser color checks, 167 director unit tests, the three-camera user journey, production build, and the real Electron output journey including both themes. Changes remain uncommitted in the existing workspace; this does not certify complete parity with the reference design.

Full contracts still report pre-existing Windows Ponytail test assumptions, historical vocabulary debt (78 > 77), and walkthrough absence assertions (53 > 52). Neither changed walkthrough adds rule hits; no gate baseline was increased.

invariant_owner_layer.why: 不变量由 src/workbench/generationCanvas/nodes/director/timeline/clipTone.ts 单点持有（即本合同的 prevention.enforcement_path / shared_boundaries）；上游其它入口只调用它、不各自重判。tests 是该层现有的类级与回归测试，改动这条不变量必先让它们红。
